entries.title: Genesis 30:1
segments: ¶Now Rachel, because she had no children, was full of envy of her sister; and she said to Jacob, If you do not give me children I will not go on living.

entries.title: Genesis 30:2
segments: But Jacob was angry with Rachel, and said, Am I in the place of God, who has kept your body from having fruit?

entries.title: Genesis 30:3
segments: Then she said, Here is my servant Bilhah, go in to her, so that she may have a child on my knees, and I may have a family by her.

entries.title: Genesis 30:4
segments: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob went in to her.

entries.title: Genesis 30:5
segments: And Bilhah became with child, and gave birth to a son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:6
segments: Then Rachel said, God has been my judge, and has given ear to my voice, and has given me a son; so he was named Dan.

entries.title: Genesis 30:7
segments: And again Bilhah, Rachel's servant, was with child, and gave birth to a second son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:8
segments: And Rachel said, I have had a great fight with my sister, and I have overcome her: and she gave the child the name Naphtali.

entries.title: Genesis 30:9
segments: When it was clear to Leah that she would have no more children for a time, she gave Zilpah, her servant, to Jacob as a wife.

entries.title: Genesis 30:10
segments: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:11
segments: And Leah said, It has gone well for me: and she gave him the name Gad.

entries.title: Genesis 30:12
segments: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a second son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:13
segments: And Leah said, Happy am I! and all women will give witness to my joy: and she gave him the name Asher.

entries.title: Genesis 30:14
segments: ¶Now at the time of the grain-cutting, Reuben saw some love-fruits in the field, and took them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to her, Let me have some of your son's love-fruits.

entries.title: Genesis 30:15
segments: But Leah said to her, Is it a small thing that you have taken my husband from me? and now would you take my son's love-fruits? Then Rachel said, You may have him tonight in exchange for your son's love-fruits.

entries.title: Genesis 30:16
segments: In the evening, when Jacob came in from the field, Leah went out to him and said, Tonight you are to come to me, for I have given my son's love-fruits as a price for you. And he went in to her that night.

entries.title: Genesis 30:17
segments: And God gave ear to her and she became with child, and gave Jacob a fifth son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:18
segments: Then Leah said, God has made payment to me for giving my servant-girl to my husband: so she gave her son the name Issachar.

entries.title: Genesis 30:19
segments: And again Leah became with child, and she gave Jacob a sixth son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:20
segments: And she said, God has given me a good bride-price; now at last will I have my husband living with me, for I have given him six sons: and she gave him the name Zebulun.

entries.title: Genesis 30:21
segments: After that she had a daughter, to whom she gave the name Dinah.

entries.title: Genesis 30:22
segments: Then God gave thought to Rachel, and hearing her prayer he made her fertile.

entries.title: Genesis 30:23
segments: And she was with child, and gave birth to a son: and she said, God has taken away my shame.

entries.title: Genesis 30:24
segments: And she gave him the name Joseph, saying, May the Lord give me another son.

entries.title: Genesis 30:25
segments: ¶Now after the birth of Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Let me go away to my place and my country.

entries.title: Genesis 30:26
segments: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have been your servant, and let me go: for you have knowledge of all the work I have done for you.

entries.title: Genesis 30:27
segments: And Laban said, If you will let me say so, do not go away; for I have seen by the signs that the Lord has been good to me because of you.

entries.title: Genesis 30:28
segments: Say then what your payment is to be and I will give it.

entries.title: Genesis 30:29
segments: Then Jacob said, You have seen what I have done for you, and how your cattle have done well under my care.

entries.title: Genesis 30:30
segments: For before I came you had little, and it has been greatly increased; and the Lord has given you a blessing in everything I have done; but when am I to do something for my family?

entries.title: Genesis 30:31
segments: And Laban said, What am I to give you? And Jacob said, Do not give me anything; but I will again take up the care of your flock if you will only do this for me:

entries.title: Genesis 30:32
segments: Let me go through all your flock today, taking out from among them all the sheep which are marked or coloured or black, and all the marked or coloured goats: these will be my payment.

entries.title: Genesis 30:33
segments: And so you will be able to put my honour to the test in time to come; if you see among my flocks any goats which are not marked or coloured, or any sheep which is not black, you may take me for a thief.

entries.title: Genesis 30:34
segments: And Laban said, Let it be as you say.

entries.title: Genesis 30:35
segments: So that day he took all the he-goats which were banded or coloured, and all the she-goats which were marked or coloured or had white marks, and all the black sheep, and gave them into the care of his sons;

entries.title: Genesis 30:36
segments: And sent them three days' journey away: and Jacob took care of the rest of Laban's flock.

entries.title: Genesis 30:37
segments: ¶Then Jacob took young branches of trees, cutting off the skin so that the white wood was seen in bands.

entries.title: Genesis 30:38
segments: And he put the banded sticks in the drinking-places where the flock came to get water; and they became with young when they came to the water.

entries.title: Genesis 30:39
segments: And because of this, the flock gave birth to young which were marked with bands of colour.

entries.title: Genesis 30:40
segments: These lambs Jacob kept separate; and he put his flock in a place by themselves and not with Laban's flock.

entries.title: Genesis 30:41
segments: And whenever the stronger ones of the flock became with young, Jacob put the sticks in front of them in the drinking-places, so that they might become with young when they saw the sticks.

entries.title: Genesis 30:42
segments: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put the sticks before them; so that the feebler flocks were Laban's and the stronger were Jacob's.

entries.title: Genesis 30:43
segments: So Jacob's wealth was greatly increased; he had great flocks and women-servants and men-servants and camels and asses.
